sentences.japanese: 間近から見ると、ものごとはその欠点や本来備わる醜さを露わにする傾向がある。
sentences.english: Seen close-up, things have a way of showing their defects, their innate ugliness.

sentences.japanese: 芝生に露が降りている。
sentences.english: Dew has formed on the lawn.

sentences.japanese: 露は太陽が昇ると蒸発した。
sentences.english: The dew evaporated when the sun rose.

sentences.japanese: 露が草の葉におりている。
sentences.english: The dew is on the leaves of grass.
